clarifying_questions: Anh/chị cần lookbook catalog, editorial hay video social; trang phục/màu/chất liệu nào phải giữ chính xác?

image_prompt_template: Fashion lookbook for: {user_request}. Preserve garment cut, color, pattern, material and customer-provided identity. Professional pose, accurate fabric, no invented branding.
video_prompt_template: Create a {scene_count}-scene fashion lookbook for: {user_request}. Keep garment and model identity consistent, show hero look, detail and motion. {aspect_ratio}, {duration_seconds}s.
